description: This file defines the 'Role' class, which extends SugarBean, representing roles within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties and methods for managing roles, such as querying related modules and users, setting relationships, and retrieving role information.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a user role with properties and methods to manage role-related data and relationships within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the role's name as its summary.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates a query for exporting role data.

methods.name: query_modules
methods.description: Retrieves module IDs associated with the role, filtered by allowance.

methods.name: set_module_relationship
methods.description: Creates relationships between the role and modules.

methods.name: clear_module_relationship
methods.description: Deletes module relationships for a role.

methods.name: clear_user_relationship
methods.description: Removes a user's association with a role.

methods.name: query_user_allowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules allowed for a user based on their roles.

methods.name: query_user_disallowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules that are disallowed for a user.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Fetches users associated with the role.

methods.name: check_user_role_count
methods.description: Counts the number of roles assigned to a user.
